decisions.reason: As a core printer line with a 2019 update, its option value remains high and keeping costs are manageable.
The software module has low marginal cost and its niche adoption is still uncertain, so the option is cheap to hold.
Although niche hardware may cost more, demand for non-absorbent surface coding remains uncertain enough to keep the option open.
The mobile app is a low-cost complement that can be maintained as an option with little resource commitment.
Inline verification supports quality assurance and its market adoption is still unresolved, favoring holding the option.
As software with low marginal cost and potential integration value, it remains a viable option worth keeping.
